name: CarrierScorecardManager
tagline: Score every carrier, fix the gaps and run better QBRs – weighted scorecards, corrective action plans and tier decisions in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete carrier performance programme for shippers, 3PLs and brokers. Weighted scorecards for on-time pickup, on-time delivery, tender acceptance, claims ratio, invoice accuracy and tracking compliance with your targets, floors, weights and grades; a league table with a KPI heat map; per-carrier trends; 14 rules that flag KPIs below the floor, required / overdue / escalated corrective action plans, declining scores, overdue QBRs, disputes and tier reviews; a CAP board with validated transitions; quarterly reviews with manager sign-off, tier decision and a generated QBR pack – in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Weighted score from six carrier KPIs with configurable targets, floors, weights and grade thresholds
League table with KPI heat map, trend and tier → recommended tier
Per-carrier trends: score on grade bands and KPI small multiples with target / floor lines
14 rules with fail / warn and next step, Act now list
Corrective action plans: Open → In progress → Verifying → Escalated → Closed, drag and drop, close only when the score recovers (manager override)
Quarterly business reviews: due dates, scheduling, manager sign-off with outcome and tier decision
Generated QBR pack agenda (QbrPackJson for Word / Teams flows)
Carrier disputes with reason and re-share
Grid with search, sort, grouping, bulk share / QBR / manager, CSV export, paging
Create / edit with validation and live score preview, undo, back / forward
Power Fx outputs and six events; ScorecardsCsv, ActionListJson, SummaryJson
controlType: standard (2 controls: niray_Niray.CarrierScorecardManager data-set + niray_Niray.CarrierScorecardManagerPortal Power Pages)
